last_digest.summary: Raised the shipped backend review deadline to 15m in config and pinned internal/backend's mirrored fallback to it via a fake-reviewer deadline probe, plus the two Backends accessors and their table tests.

New standard-library-only `internal/deadline` package with `Close`/`Verify`/`GateReview`/`Session`, saturating arithmetic, the overflow-safe ceil, and the moved `Grace` constant, covered by table tests for containment, the wave budget, saturation boundaries and monotonicity (100% coverage, lint clean).

close-wave now runs openTarget/landedClose under deadline.Bootstrap and the remaining close under deadline.Close of a new pure closeBudget built from a single index read, with verify and gate review taking deadline.Verify/deadline.GateReview and the three local constants deleted.

Nil-index wave facts now budget zero work on both counts (with an active-wave test), the finish verify count is gathered only while unverified and off the single already-parsed index, the `ReadExtra` error path is tested, and the decide verify-timeout test is split into subtests.
last_digest.blockers: none — except that the residual `ReadExtra`+`UnionCommands` overlap with `verifyAtHead` cannot be factored without `internal/cli/cmd_verify.go` in scope.

last_digest.summary: Added `TestReviewErrorToleratesAMalformedBackendsContext` to internal/decide/decide_test.go covering all four of `backendDeadlines`' defensive guards including the bare-key-no-deadline rendering (mutation-checked, 100% coverage); assessed the "undeclared workflow artifacts" finding as a false positive about takt's own bookkeeping and left the facts.go/config duplication for a task that has internal/config in scope.

preparePushPR now commits finish/pr.md ("pr body") after writing it, threaded through a new ctx parameter on run/preparePushPR; added TestPushPRLeavesTheBodyInHead and updated brief_stable_test.go's two direct callers plus its zero-workspace no-op assertion.

The `pr` disposition's archived stop now hands back `git push [-u] origin <branch>` exactly when git says the branch holds commits the remote-tracking ref does not (diverged included), degrades to the push when either git read fails, and never fails the stop; covered by one end-to-end test over all four rows and two internal tests for the two read failures.

Made all four planned documentation edits (README 15m x2, design-doc 15m x2, derived-budget rule, corrected pr-archive prose in §7.5 and §5.2) plus the unscripted fifth edit correcting the hard-coded `timeout_s: 1800` close-wave example at line 462 to show a derived, non-constant value; all seven grep verifies and the full `task check` gate pass.
